findings.title: Purification and particularization before office
findings.claim: Musa's mukhlas status can be read as a purified and set-apart relation that precedes the rasul and nabi offices named afterward.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier at 19:51:7:1 is connected to wider selected-servant and exclusive-relation occurrences at 15:40, 12:24, 38:83, 20:41, 7:144, 17:55, and 37:114. The rasul and nabi carriers at 19:51:9:1 and 19:51:10:1 are connected to wider message-bearing and divine-news relations at 42:51, 62:2, 2:151, 7:104, 22:52, 7:157, and 7:158. Returning those wider triggers through the three focus carriers makes the focus sequence readable as a prepared relation opening into public office.
findings.reader_payoff: The two office nouns are not left as a flat pair of labels: they follow a bounded account of a person made clear and distinct for the transmission of divine news.
findings.containment: The primary floor remains that Moses was selected, a messenger, and a prophet. This finding does not decide whether the passive mukhlas form foregrounds purification or selection, does not infer a complete doctrine of exclusive devotion, and does not claim that the wider target forms have supplied morphology or lexical analysis.

epistemic.reason: The candidate's cross-run support is trusted and anchored to the focus branches. The wider connection records provide exact target Arabic and ranked relations but no target-side morphology, so the global synthesis is qualified.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyde daha önce bulunan karışım, bulanıklık ya da kir giderilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The passive mukhlas predicate at 19:51:7:1 carries the local state before the office nouns.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied wider occurrences at 15:40, 12:24, and 38:83 place the same root family in selected-servant contexts.
branch_activations.activation: Those wider selected-servant contexts return through the focus predicate and make removal of mixture a live, bounded reading of the preparation before office.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Musa is presented as purified before the text names him as rasul and nabi.
branch_activations.boundary: This activation does not settle target-side morphology or erase the selection reading.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Giderme işleminin sonucu, şeyin duru ve katkısız bir duruma gelmesidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus predicate is the state-bearing carrier between the remembrance frame and the office pair.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The selected-servant connections supply wider contexts in which the root family marks a distinct, unshared standing.
branch_activations.activation: The wider standing returns through the focus carrier as a result-state rather than as a new office or event.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The office-bearing relation is received through a clear and undiluted status.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a reading of the focus relation only; it does not turn the target occurrences into proof of the exact focus facet.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey belirli bir kişi ya da topluluğa özgülenir ve başkalarının ortaklığı dışlanır.
branch_activations.carrier: The passive focus predicate carries Moses's relation of being set apart.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied Musa connections describe being made for God, chosen above people, and favored in relation to prophetic distinction.
branch_activations.activation: Those wider particularization triggers return through mukhlas and restrict the reading to a relation in which Musa is singled out before the two office names.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The selection is an exclusive assignment of the bearer to a divinely commissioned role, not a generic compliment.
branch_activations.boundary: The finding does not infer solitary mission or deny Aaron's co-prophetic role elsewhere.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek, bir gönderenden bir alıcıya içerik taşıyan ileti bağını kurar.
branch_activations.carrier: The rasul noun at 19:51:9:1 carries the outward-facing communication role.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wider connections pair messenger language with divine communication, recitation, teaching, and delivery of the Book.
branch_activations.activation: The communication relation returns through rasul and turns the office from an honorific label into a sender-to-recipient transmission role.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Musa's messenger office is the outward channel through which the prepared relation bears content to people.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not supply a complete account of the sender, recipient, or medium in every wider connection.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi okumasında, taşıyıcı gönderen adına haberleri izleyen ve aktaran görevlidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The person-denoting rasul carrier sits after the focus status and before nabi.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wider messenger passages describe an entrusted person who conveys, recites, or teaches received content.
branch_activations.activation: Those role triggers return through the person reading of rasul and specify a commissioned bearer rather than an abstract message.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The office is carried by Musa as an entrusted transmitter.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not claim that every target messenger occurrence has the same person-versus-message morphology.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wider connections repeatedly pair rasul and nabi or place Musa in an explicit divine messenger setting.
branch_activations.activation: Those paired-office and Musa-messenger triggers return through nabi and keep the office within a God-to-human announcement relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The prophetic title completes the public divine-news role opened by rasul.
branch_activations.boundary: The pairing is not used to resolve a general rasul-nabi taxonomy beyond this focus.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Görev, Tanrı ile akıl sahibi insanlar arasında kutsal bir elçilik bağı kurar.

branch_activations.activation: The bridge relation returns through nabi and makes the final office noun a relational task, not merely a rank.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Musa's prophetic office is the human-facing completion of the divine communication relation.
branch_activations.boundary: No target-side morphology is supplied, and the activation does not generalize the office to every prophet reference.

findings.title: Book remembrance as durable textual presentation
findings.claim: The command to mention Musa in the Book can also be heard as a wider textual act that brings a named figure into a durable narrative record.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier at 19:51:1:2 is connected to the same book-remembrance frame at 19:16 and to wider remembrance commands or records at 94:4, 76:25, 38:17, and 19:2. Returning those triggers through the spoken-mention carrier makes the opening phrase more than private recollection: it presents Musa for continued textual availability.
findings.reader_payoff: Musa enters the reader's field as a deliberately preserved figure whose mention remains available for return.
findings.containment: The ordinary command to remember remains intact. This finding does not make every dhikr occurrence equivalent, does not turn remembrance into a claim about honor in every context, and does not supply target-side morphology for the wider connections.

epistemic.reason: The exact target Arabic and connection notes support a bounded textual-resonance reading, but the target records do not include morphology or a citable trusted source label.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wider connections repeat book-remembrance and named-figure remembrance frames, including 19:16, 94:4, 76:25, 38:17, and 19:2.
branch_activations.activation: Those remembrance triggers return through the focus imperative as a textual act of saying and naming rather than an unmarked mental state.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Musa is intentionally named for durable narrative presentation in the Book.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation does not collapse verbal remembrance into all meanings of the root.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Söz aracılığıyla bir şeyi bildirme veya görünür kılma yönünü taşır.

findings.title: The Book as a carrier of prophetic record
findings.claim: The phrase fi al-kitab can also be heard as the written record that carries Musa's prophetic placement, not merely a container in which his name happens to occur.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier at 19:51:3:2 meets repeated wider pairings of Musa with the Book at 2:53, 23:49, 11:17, and 32:23, as well as the Book's relation to rusul and public proof at 57:25. Returning those exact target triggers through the written-text facet makes the Book a carrier of transmitted prophetic continuity.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can receive the Book as an active record that preserves and carries the office-bearing history, not as a passive location marker.
findings.containment: The floor meaning remains in the Book. This does not claim that every Book occurrence has the same function, does not resolve target morphology, and does not turn the global connection set into a surah-wide thesis.

epistemic.reason: Multiple exact target connections support the written-record relation, but their target morphology and lexical analysis are absent from the packet.

branch_activations.carrier: The noun al-kitab at 19:51:3:2 carries the written-record location of the command.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wider connections repeatedly join Musa, the Book, guidance, mercy, or prophetic proof.
branch_activations.activation: Those pairings return through al-kitab and make the written object a carrier of remembered prophetic continuity.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The Book is the durable written medium through which Musa's office-bearing account is preserved.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation does not infer the morphology or full discourse role of any target Book expression.

findings.title: The Book as binding and guiding reference
findings.claim: The Book's written presence also carries a binding and guiding force: the record in which Musa is remembered can function as a reference that directs and judges.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier at 19:51:3:2 is connected to wider Book pairings with Furqan, guidance, imam, mercy, and public proof at 2:53, 32:23, 11:17, and 57:25. Returning those triggers through the binding-as-determination branch makes al-kitab more active than a shelf or location while preserving the local wording.
findings.reader_payoff: The remembered account can be read within a Book that does work for the reader, directing attention and providing a standard for reception.
findings.containment: This is a bounded functional resonance, not a claim that the focus clause states a complete legal code or that every target Book occurrence is prescriptive. Target morphology and broader context remain unavailable.

epistemic.reason: The exact target connections name guidance and authoritative functions, but the packet does not provide target morphology or enough context to make the binding facet more than exploratory.

findings.title: Divine selection as the source of particularization
findings.claim: The passive mukhlas form also admits a divine-selection reading: wider direct addresses to Musa describe him as made for God and chosen, so the focus predicate can mark God's act of setting him apart before the offices.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier at 19:51:7:1 is connected to 20:41, 7:144, and 37:114, where the supplied Arabic and notes frame Musa as made for God, chosen above people, or specially favored. Returning those triggers through the divine-particularization branch distinguishes a God-initiated setting apart from self-made religious direction.
findings.reader_payoff: Musa's distinct status appears as received divine assignment rather than a distinction he creates for himself.
findings.containment: This finding isolates divine agency and does not replace the accepted purification-before-office finding. It does not activate the active devotional branch, does not settle the passive form's morphology, and does not claim solitary mission.

epistemic.reason: The wider Musa connections directly support a selection relation, but the target records lack supplied morphology and lexical analysis.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wider Musa passages describe being made for God, chosen above people, and favored together with Aaron.
branch_activations.activation: Those divine-selection triggers return through mukhlas and foreground God's act of choosing the person.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Musa's particularization is received as divine selection before his public titles.
branch_activations.boundary: The connection set does not decide whether the focus form itself expresses selection, purification, or both.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişilerin kendi yönelişinden çok Tanrı tarafından seçilip ona ayrılmaları belirleyicidir.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The status is a divine assignment that prepares the messenger-prophet role.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not activate the separate branch for active devotional orientation toward God.

findings.title: Kana as established standing
findings.claim: The two kana constructions can also make Musa's selection and paired office a settled standing carried across time, rather than a momentary sequence of labels.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers at 19:51:6:1 and 19:51:8:2 are connected to wider kana descriptions at 33:40, 33:69, and 28:59. Returning those status-reporting triggers through the occurrence-and-being branch gives the repeated copulas a bounded role in presenting an established identity around the office pair.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the two kana clauses as a steady profile of Musa, with the office relation presented as something that is established and reportable.
findings.containment: This is a limited copular resonance, not a claim about every meaning of kana, creation, location, or tense in the wider targets. The packet does not supply target-side morphology, so the standing reading remains exploratory.

epistemic.reason: The focus has two resolved kana carriers and the wider target texts are exact connection suggestions, but the packet does not provide target morphology sufficient to establish a shared grammatical function.

branch_activations.boundary: The target-side grammatical function is not supplied, so this remains an exploratory relation.
